statement.text:
Let ω(G, S) be the exponential growth rate of a group G with a finite gen-
erating set S (see 14.7). Let M CG(Σg ) be the mapping class group of the orientable
surface Σg of genus g. Is there a constant C > 1 such that ω(M CG(Σg ), S) ⩾ C for
every g > 0 and every finite generating set S of M CG(Σg )?             K. Fujiwara
  ∗ No, there is no such constant that works for all genera; but if the genus g is fixed,
then such a constant C = C(g) > 1 does exist (J. Mangahas, Geom. Funct. Anal.
19, no. 5 (2010), 1468–1480).
